notablePrerequisites: Your library size is greater than or equal to an opponent's life total.
description:
Cast Body of Reaserch by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to your library size.
Cast Kazuul's Fury by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing the Fractal, dealing damage equal to the Fractal's power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
